sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: Acquaintance is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

sections.heading: Dialogue
sections.text: "Well, hello there! I could use your help right now. We're still barely acquainted, so I won't ask you to handle anything too serious just yet. I'm a solitary man, as you've probably already noticed. I try to live by my own principles and keep Tarkov clean. That takes time and effort, and sometimes my supplies run out. Usually when I least expect it. Could you find me some provisions? I don't need anything special, anything will do. The only requirement is that it's edible."
